method: Rehash both resource files against catalog pins, parse WASM section headers and ASCII strings from data sections, resolve embedded abbreviated revisions through primary repository commit APIs. No source rebuild was performed. Embedded revision strings self-report selected build inputs and do not prove complete source or clean working trees.

archive.inspection: Extracted only the catalog JS/WASM filenames using a file include list. 49 exact pairs matched both catalog hashes. The archive PCSX pair did not match, so a separately retained exact pinned pair was used.

sdkContext.limitations: The historical Dockerfile pins Emscripten 3.1.46 and the template selects the mutable latest container tag. The source files and embedded compiler identity do not establish the exact SDK/container used for each pinned pair. CI also reuses precompiled RetroArch artifacts and Emscripten caches.
